result.summary: VERDICT FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930). Scope: HTTP bearer auth, public-host policy, timing/error paths, auth consistency across health/events/MCP. 6 findings, no CRITICAL/HIGH. MEDIUM: src/serve.ts:179 metrics listener has no host allowlist and no bearer auth while binding the same public SWARMFORGE_HOST (reproduced 200 with no token, wrong token, arbitrary Host while the API port 401s; leaks team ids, worker states, model name); src/http.ts:31 exact origin equality 403s browser clients behind the documented TLS-terminating reverse proxy after successful auth (reproduced on /health and /events). LOW: bearer compare short-circuits on byte length so timingSafeEqual never runs; host allowlist matched case-sensitively; absent Host header throws pre-auth as an unhandled 500 with stack-trace logging; 401 lacks WWW-Authenticate. Guards verified sound: gate order host-auth-origin, 404 only after auth, unlisted Host refused even with a valid token, token required for every non-loopback host, token redacted on /events and MCP. Artifacts in /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/, logs in /workspace/.swarmforge/logs/.
result.details:
Target verified in a disposable detached clone at /tmp/sf19/r (git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895); /workspace/repo left clean at assigned baseline 5672ead2a526e07fea9ed11e58b3725e42013527. Bun 1.4.2 unpacked to /tmp/sf19 (snapshot Bun 1.3.14 cannot read lockfileVersion 2); lockfile never rewritten. src/http.ts and src/config.ts are unchanged from baseline; src/serve.ts is new and the unauthenticated metrics listener was carried over verbatim from the deleted src/main.ts, so finding 1 is pre-existing rather than introduced by this branch.

F1 MEDIUM src/serve.ts:179-190. The second Bun.serve (SWARMFORGE_METRICS_PORT, same SWARMFORGE_HOST) has an inline fetch that only checks the /metrics path; neither the accepted-host set nor the bearer gate from createHttpHandler is applied. The non-loopback token invariant is enforced only in config.ts superRefine and implemented on one of two listeners. Reproduced on a live startServer with SWARMFORGE_HOST=0.0.0.0 plus a token: /metrics returned 200 with no Authorization header, 200 with a wrong token, and 200 with an arbitrary Host header, while /health on the API port returned 401. Unauthenticated body after a spawn showed swarmforge_workers{team="team",state="queued"}, swarmforge_workers_created_total{team="team"} and swarmforge_tokens_total{team="team",model=...}. No test covers metrics authorization. Fix: reuse the extracted host+auth gate, or give metrics its own credential/allowlist, or default a loopback-only metrics bind.

F2 MEDIUM src/http.ts:31. `origin !== url.origin` compares against the scheme+authority Bun derives from the forwarded Host header, which is always http under the TLS-terminating reverse proxy that src/config.ts:13-15 and docs/ENVIRONMENT.md:33 explicitly target. Because the check runs after the bearer check, a valid client gets 403 Forbidden origin. Reproduced over a real socket: Host mcp.example.com with a valid token plus Origin https://mcp.example.com gave 403 on /health and /events; the same request without Origin gave 200. tests/http.test.ts only asserts the hostile-origin reject path. Fix: compare the origin host to the accepted-host set, or add an explicit allowed-origins list.

F3 LOW src/http.ts:25 length short-circuit; 120000 interleaved in-process samples gave 0.00184 / 0.00221 / 0.00241 ms medians (len8 / same-len-wrong / correct). Code-evidenced; network exploitability not measured. Fix: compare sha256 digests.

F4 LOW src/http.ts:13 vs config.ts:11-12. Allowlist entries are trimmed but not lowercased while URL.hostname always is; SWARMFORGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=MCP.Example.COM loads fine yet 403s for both lowercase and uppercase request hosts. Fail-closed. Fix: normalize once, or share an acceptedHosts() helper.

F5 LOW src/http.ts:8. Unguarded new URL(request.url) throws on an HTTP/1.0 request with no Host header, before the host and auth checks, escaping the handler and startupGate: reproduced HTTP/1.1 500 with a stack trace on stderr including absolute paths. Fix: try/catch returning 400 and reject an absent Host early.

F6 LOW src/http.ts:28. 401 carries no WWW-Authenticate challenge (observed null on every 401). Fix: add a Bearer realm challenge.

No CRITICAL/HIGH: the gate order host then auth then origin then route is correct and uniform across /health, /events and /mcp; 404 happens only after auth so there is no unauthenticated route enumeration; an unlisted Host is refused even with a valid token; config rejects every non-loopback host or public allowed host without a token; and the API token is redacted on both event and MCP surfaces. No secrets or real credentials appear in any artifact.

result.followup_reason: Two MEDIUM auth defects are actionable. (1) src/serve.ts:179-190: the metrics listener serves /metrics with no bearer token and no host allowlist on the same public SWARMFORGE_HOST, reproduced returning 200 unauthenticated, so the config-level non-loopback token invariant only protects the API port. (2) src/http.ts:31: exact origin equality refuses browser clients behind the documented TLS-terminating reverse proxy with 403 after successful auth, reproduced on /health and /events over a real socket. Four LOW items also warrant fixes: length short-circuit before timingSafeEqual, case-sensitive host allowlist, unguarded URL parse that escapes the handler pre-auth as a 500, and a missing WWW-Authenticate challenge.
